output_list.criticism: The function GetStats() is used to get the current round, time to end, current stage sum and max stage eth amount. The function uses the current time to determine the current stage. However, the current time is obtained using the now keyword which is a built-in function in Solidity. This built-in function is not secure as it can be manipulated by miners to influence the outcome of the function. This vulnerability can lead to incorrect results and potentially loss of funds. The correctness of this function is rated as 7 out of 9, severity as 8 out of 9, and profitability as 6 out of 9.
